title: Kota in Slack: Ask Anything. Where You Already Live.
summary: Bring Hyperbound into Slack. Ask anything about your calls, deals, and coaching, and get instant, data-backed answers without leaving your workflow.
body_markdown:
Revenue teams today aren’t lacking visibility.


They can see:


- what happened on calls
- how reps performed in roleplays
- where deals are progressing or stalling
- what coaching has already been given


But visibility doesn’t automatically translate into action.


To answer even simple questions — what went wrong on my last call, what should I improve, which deals need attention — you still have to open the platform, navigate to the right place, and piece together context across multiple features.


The information is there, but getting to it takes time.


And because of that, it’s often underused in the moments where it would matter most.


## **What We Built: Kota, Now Inside Slack**


Kota is Hyperbound’s AI revenue assistant. It understands your calls, your coaching data, your roleplays, and your deals.


Now, it’s available directly inside Slack.


Instead of opening Hyperbound and searching for answers, you can message Kota the same way you’d message a teammate. You ask a question, and it responds with insights pulled from your actual data — not generic suggestions, but context grounded in your environment.


There’s no new workflow to learn. No menus to click through.


Just a conversation.


## **What Changes: From Navigating a System to Asking It Questions**


Most tools are designed around navigation.


If you want to understand a call, you go to calls.If you want to review performance, you go to scorecards.If you want to check deals, you go to your pipeline.


Kota removes that step.


You start with the question instead of the location.


A rep can ask:
“What were the key objections in my last demo call?”


Kota doesn’t just summarize the call. It surfaces the specific objections, highlights where the rep struggled to respond, and connects that back to missed opportunities or coaching gaps.


A manager can ask:
“Which deals are most likely to slip this week?”


Instead of a static list, Kota points to specific deals, explains why they’re at risk based on recent activity or call signals, and shows what’s missing.


A RevOps leader can ask:
“Where are deals consistently stalling in our pipeline?”


Kota can surface patterns across stages, highlight where momentum drops off, and connect that back to what’s happening in calls or deal activity.


A sales leader can ask:
“What are top reps doing differently than the rest of the team?”


Kota can compare behaviors across calls — from how reps handle objections to how they run discovery — and show what’s actually driving better outcomes.


An enablement lead can ask:
“What patterns are we seeing across discovery calls?”


Kota identifies recurring gaps — whether reps aren’t asking enough questions, skipping key topics, or struggling with positioning — and summarizes that across the team.


No digging across different views. No stitching context together yourself.


Just the answer, based on what’s actually happening.


## **How It Actually Works in Practice**


Once Slack is connected, Kota shows up as a direct message — just like any other app.


From there, it’s simple. You type your question normally, and Kota responds based on your Hyperbound data.


That answer might include:


- a summary of what happened
- specific examples or moments from calls
- patterns across multiple interactions
- suggested areas to improve
- or next steps to take


Because it’s connected to your full instance, a single question can pull from calls, scorecards, roleplays, and deal activity all at once.


And because it’s in Slack, it happens instantly without breaking your flow.


## **How Kota in Slack Works With Hyperbound Perform**


Kota in Slack doesn’t just answer your prompted questions. It can also show up at the right moments, without you asking.


When connected with Hyperbound Perform, Kota becomes more proactive in how it supports reps and managers throughout the day.


At the end of each day, Kota can send your team a summary of what’s ahead — surfacing upcoming calls and giving context on what to expect.


Ahead of a call, Kota can step in again. About 15 minutes before, it can prompt you with quick, targeted roleplays based on that specific conversation — giving you a chance to practice the exact scenario you’re about to walk into.


And when managers assign bite-sized roleplays, those show up directly in Slack as well. Instead of getting lost in a queue or buried in the platform, reps are notified immediately and can jump in right away.


The result is a more continuous loop.


Not just asking questions when you think to, but getting nudges, prep, and practice exactly when they’re most useful.


## **Why This Is Valuable**


Kota has never been more accessible.


Even the best systems get underused if they require extra steps to access. Not because the insights aren’t valuable, but because they live behind navigation, context switching, and time.


Slack removes that friction.


It’s already open for most of the workday. Teams are constantly in it — talking through deals, prepping for calls, asking for help. It’s where questions naturally happen.


Kota meets that moment.


Instead of opening another tool and digging for answers, you just ask — right where you already are.


That’s what changes behavior.


Insights stop being something you review after the fact, and start becoming something you use in real time — before a call, while working a deal, or in the middle of coaching.


## **Final Thoughts**


Your sales system already knows what’s happening.


Kota just makes it easier to ask.

If you’re new to Hyperbound, you can learn more about how Kota works and how teams are using it to turn insights into action[here](https://www.hyperbound.ai/blog/kota-a-way-out-of-static-dashboards-and-into-actionable-insights) !
